name: Wireless Noise-Cancelling Headphones
description: Premium over-ear headphones with active noise cancellation, 30-hour battery life, and Hi-Res Audio support. Features memory foam ear cushions for all-day comfort and multipoint Bluetooth connectivity.

name: Ultra-Slim Laptop Stand
description: Ergonomic aluminum laptop stand with adjustable height and angle. Compatible with all laptops up to 17 inches. Improves airflow and reduces neck strain.

name: Smart Fitness Watch Pro
description: Advanced fitness tracker with AMOLED display, GPS, heart rate monitoring, SpO2 sensor, and 14-day battery life. Water-resistant to 50 meters with 100+ workout modes.

name: Portable Bluetooth Speaker
description: 360° immersive sound with deep bass. IP67 waterproof and dustproof design, 20-hour playtime, and built-in power bank. Perfect for outdoor adventures.

name: Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
description: Full-size mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable switches, per-key RGB lighting, and aircraft-grade aluminum frame. N-key rollover with programmable macros.

name: Premium Merino Wool Sweater
description: Luxuriously soft 100% extra-fine merino wool crew-neck sweater. Temperature regulating and naturally odor-resistant. Available in classic colors.

name: Slim-Fit Chino Pants
description: Modern slim-fit chinos crafted from stretch cotton twill. Features a comfortable mid-rise waist and tapered leg. Wrinkle-resistant for easy care.

name: Waterproof Hiking Jacket
description: 3-layer waterproof breathable shell jacket with sealed seams. Features adjustable hood, pit zips for ventilation, and multiple zippered pockets.

name: Classic Leather Sneakers
description: Minimalist white leather sneakers with cushioned insoles and durable rubber outsoles. Hand-stitched detailing for a premium finish that only gets better with age.

name: Performance Running Tee
description: Ultralight moisture-wicking running shirt with flatlock seams and reflective details. Made from recycled polyester with UPF 30+ sun protection.

name: Artisan Ceramic Vase Set
description: Set of 3 hand-thrown ceramic vases in complementary earth tones. Each piece is unique with a matte glaze finish. Perfect for dried flowers or as standalone décor.

name: Scandinavian Floor Lamp
description: Minimalist tripod floor lamp with solid oak legs and a linen drum shade. Warm ambient lighting with a dimmable LED bulb included. 150cm height.

name: Weighted Linen Throw Blanket
description: Stonewashed French linen throw with a gentle drape. Pre-washed for softness and naturally temperature-regulating. Fits standard sofas at 150×200cm.

name: Bamboo Desk Organizer
description: Multi-compartment bamboo organizer with phone stand, pen holder, and mail sorter. Sustainably sourced bamboo with smooth sanded edges and natural oil finish.

name: Aromatherapy Candle Set
description: Set of 4 soy wax candles in hand-poured concrete vessels. Scents include Lavender Fields, Cedar & Sage, Ocean Breeze, and Vanilla Chai. 45-hour burn time each.

name: Leather Crossbody Bag
description: Full-grain vegetable-tanned leather crossbody with adjustable strap. Features internal zip pocket, card slots, and magnetic closure. Develops a beautiful patina over time.

name: Titanium Aviator Sunglasses
description: Ultra-lightweight titanium frame aviators with polarized Carl Zeiss lenses. 100% UV400 protection with anti-reflective coating. Includes leather case.

name: Minimalist Automatic Watch
description: Japanese automatic movement with sapphire crystal glass. 40mm case in brushed stainless steel with a genuine Italian leather strap. Water-resistant to 100m.

name: Wool & Cashmere Scarf
description: Luxurious blend of 70% merino wool and 30% cashmere. Generous oversized dimensions at 200×70cm. Available in timeless herringbone and solid patterns.

name: Carbon Fiber Card Holder
description: Ultra-slim RFID-blocking cardholder in genuine carbon fiber. Holds up to 12 cards with a quick-access pull tab. Weighs just 30 grams.
